query: What is an optimal short core battery (max ~15 minutes) for repeated measurement across sites, and what IRT/DIF psychometric checks will ensure cross-site validity?

response.query: What is an optimal short core battery (max ~15 minutes) for repeated measurement across sites, and what IRT/DIF psychometric checks will ensure cross-site validity?
response.answer: An optimal short core battery is the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) for 15 minutes. IRT checks and DIF analysis ensure cross-site validity.
